facts.fact: The Autentika page says a citizen may authenticate with the CNI at any Cabo Verdean public administration portal that has joined Autentika, and that any duly authorised application may integrate by OpenID Connect; no date is given, so as_of is the published year (proxy).
The Autentika page states that more than 95,000 users use the platform daily to reach work applications; no count of relying services is given, and the date is the published year (proxy).
